title: Next up in International Artist: How to Paint More Efficiently
content: Painting efficiently is not just about painting quickly—it's about getting a lot done in whatever amount of time you've got.Efficiency is not the main goal in art. Sometimes in the controlled conditions of the studio you might want to throw away the clock. But having those skills can really help when you're facing the rapidly shifting conditions of just about any outdoor motif.That's what I cover in the next issue ofInternational Artist Magazine, issue #122 (August / September 2018).
